headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 10, 2026**
article:
The day's top MLB news saw the Cincinnati Reds fall to the Washington Nationals in a 7-1 loss, while the Athletics secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox. The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 11-1, and the Philadelphia Phillies edged the Toronto Blue Jays in a thrilling finish.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays due to right elbow discomfort. Other notable injuries include Cooper Pratt (right hamstring strain) and Ben Williamson (right hamstring strain) for the Milwaukee Brewers and Tampa Bay Rays, respectively.

The Kansas City Royals made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in Dominant 7-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a tough defeat at the hands of the Washington Nationals, who won 7-1. Abimelec Ortiz led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Brad Lord pitched 2.2 strong innings for the Reds.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, with a final score of 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with a 3-hit performance.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Pirates 11-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way for the Mets, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 7-6 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Kyle Schwarber leading the charge at the plate. Schwarber hit two home runs and drove in four runs, while Jesús Luzardo pitched 7.0 innings with 12 strikeouts for the Blue Jays.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Griffin Jax on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as part of a trade.
